name: vSphere health report
summary: Read-only health check of hosts, alarms, clusters, datastores, snapshots and VMware Tools.
description: Produces an HTML report and one CSV per section: host connection / maintenance / build / uptime, triggered alarms, cluster HA / DRS / EVC configuration, datastore free space against the site minimum, snapshots older than N days and VMware Tools issues. Optionally searches every datastore for orphaned VMDK files (slow). Nothing is changed.

inputs.name: IncludeOrphanedVmdk
inputs.label: Search for orphaned VMDK files
inputs.help: Browses every datastore; can take a long time on large sites. Results are candidates to review, never deleted.
